sources.name: Project Watch, GitHub orgs and repos, all niches
sources.notes: Releases and dev activity straight from the GitHub organisations and flagship repos of watched projects across every niche: Privacy (Zama, Arcium, Miden, Aztec, Midnight, Nillion, Fhenix, Aleo), AI (Sentient, Gensyn, Prime Intellect, ElizaOS, Bittensor, Fetch.ai, NEAR AI, Venice, Ritual) and Agentic Wallet (Binance skills hub, Coinbase AgentKit, Solana Agent Kit, Crossmint), plus sweep coverage of their blogs, docs and X accounts. Builder signal, not news.

sources.name: CoinGecko Trending (keyless API)
sources.notes: Trending coins, NFTs and categories in the last 24h. No key needed, shared rate limits, so the updater calls it once per run.

sources.name: CoinMarketCap Keyless API
sources.notes: Latest listings, trending, gainers and global metrics from the public keyless routes. Full news and community posts are sweep-only.

sources.name: GitHub Search API
sources.notes: Repository search for privacy, ZK, AI agent and agentic wallet projects, sorted by recently updated. Unauthenticated limit is 10 requests per minute, the updater uses 3 queries per run.

sources.name: X / Twitter (project accounts, alpha callers, Binance Wallet, privacy and AI projects)
sources.notes: No usable public API and a login wall, so X is covered by Muse sweeps, not the auto updater. This is where the earliest signals live, so sweeps prioritise it.

sources.name: Binance Announcements, Binance Alpha and Binance Square
sources.notes: No official RSS. Listings, HODLer Airdrops, Alpha points events and wallet updates are sweep-only.

sources.name: CoinMarketCap Community and Headlines pages
sources.notes: Beyond the keyless API data, trending narratives and community alpha are sweep-only.

sources.name: NFT marketplaces and mint calendars (OpenSea, Blur, Magic Eden, Elysium and mint indexes)
sources.notes: New mints, trending collections and notable sales. Sales data has no free keyless API, so this is sweep-only.

sources.name: Project blogs, Medium, Mirror, governance forums and GitHub releases for watched projects
sources.notes: Watched list lives in config/rules.json: Zcash, Aztec, Midnight, Venice, Sentient, Binance Agentic Wallet / Agent ID ecosystem, Starknet and others as the brand evolves.

sources.name: Telegram and Discord announcement channels (including DakSHado Telegram)
sources.notes: Read-only monitoring of public announcement channels only.
